assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One isolated reusable raster asset for Threadbound's side-scrolling 2D game. Reference image is style guidance: dimensional low-poly volumes, clean large polygonal faces with delicate directional mineral striations or interlaced wood grain, subtle woven-looking linework, moss green, neutral slate grey, warm wood, pink blossom accents. Match soft daylight from upper left, three main values per material, readable clean silhouette. STRICT SIDE-ON ORTHOGRAPHIC ELEVATION, only a very shallow top-plane reveal, not isometric, no receding path. NO characters, UI, grid, labels, text, watermark, background scenery, sky, water, floor plane, drop shadow or baked checkerboard. Genuine transparent alpha around the complete asset, with narrow but safe clear margins, all object edges fully inside canvas. Do not make a scene or a sheet of multiple objects. This is a MASSIVE FULL-DEPTH GROUND CHUNK, not a floating platform, boulder, island or thin ledge. Approximately 3:2 width-to-height canvas. One continuous walkable moss and worn pale stone rim runs LEVEL and HORIZONTAL across almost the entire top. A restrained thin moss fringe with a few small grass tufts defines this clear top edge; do not put trees or boulders on it. Below that top edge, thick vertical SLATE CLIFF ROCK extends DOWN TO A BROAD FLAT LOWER CUT across the full base width. The lower 90 percent is rock, not empty space. Left and right cliff sides are nearly vertical with a slight natural broken silhouette; no tapered island tip, no narrowing pedestal, no rounded underside, no arch, no cave, no openings. Broad vertical and diagonal faceted rock planes with sparse subtle woven-directional mineral lines. Rock faces are about the size of an adult torso, not hundreds of tiny noisy triangles. Opaque continuous rock from the walkable top to the bottom cut, so the chunk can extend BELOW the camera view. This whole deep piece will be reused as a stamp, never sliced into small repeated tiles. Keep the material scale and upper-left lighting consistent. Variation A: broad stable lakeside cliff, fairly regular sides, slate mid-grey, a couple of long diagonal seams running down through large irregular planes. Thin green moss lip, no pink flowers. Straight level usable top across 96 percent of width.
